sources.title: Do-It-Yourself Feng Shui
sources.quality_notes: Direct recheck L179–188: interview identifies Merlina Merton using clients' natal four pillars for individualized feng shui, specifies paired stems/branches for birth year/month/day/hour. Local contemporary reported use, not proof of 1988 Bazi practice, precise calculation method, lineage or first introduction.

sources.title: Experts offer Zi Wei Dou Shu course in Cebu City
sources.quality_notes: Direct recheck L29–44,57–62: Wyson Chan and Ng Choon Phong named, Cebu Parklane preview Aug25 and September 8–11,22–23 planned. Advertised historical claims not accepted as proof. Same event group as Freeman; not evidence of completed course or independent Bazi teaching.

sources.title: Feng shui, destiny science as business now booming
sources.quality_notes: Direct recheck L125–144: reports Aug25 preview took place; planned main course Sep8–11,21–22 differs from SunStar schedule. Two distinct dated newspaper articles for one event cluster, shared promotional wording, not independent lineage witnesses. Manila plans and Philippine academy not proof of establishment.

sources.title: Plan Your Destiny with Dato Joey Yap
sources.provider: Joey Yap practitioner-site republication of Francis L. Bonnevie, BusinessMirror
sources.historical_period: 2015-02-19 republication metadata; 2015-01-29 reported Manila speaking event; publisher archive dates 2015-02-18
sources.quality_notes: Direct recheck L124–160: distinguishes Bazi from Feng Shui, explains four birth pairs; Manila Marriott interview and event reported. Publisher archive https://businessmirror.com.ph/category/business/perspective/page/18/ confirms title/author/Feb18; original article direct retrieval HTTP429. One interview record, not two independent witnesses, not proof of national introduction.

sources.title: Vicente: Four pillars of destiny
sources.quality_notes: Direct recheck L170–179,186–191: associated columnist reports two practitioners computing separately and consulting notes attributed to Raymond Lo. Commercial context; no independent teacher confirmation, original case chart or mechanical rule. Do not endorse health or efficacy assertions.

sources.title: Four Pillars of Destiny Celebrity Charts
sources.historical_period: 2017-12-07 author report of 2017-11-19 Manila convention presentation
sources.quality_notes: Direct recheck L1–24: presenter describes Four Pillars day-master/classification talk; bio reports separate Bazi training with Lily Chung and Ziwei with Tony Tan. Self-report only, no independent lineage or proof of Ziwei teaching at Manila meeting. No original programme verified.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Two Cebu reports share one event group; no completed September course or national first.
Publisher archive and practitioner republication are one interview, not independent witnesses.
Named teachers and training biographies remain reported, not confirmed lineage.
1988 overseas practitioner lead not Philippine local chronology.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Earlier independent Philippine Bazi and Ziwei records; 2003 original newspaper; 2013 completion and teaching materials; 2015 original article full text; 2016 mentor evidence; 2017 programme and recorded presentation; 1988 overseas lead deduplication.
